```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/R Code/gc-processing/")
```

Purpose: Process GC data to get soil chamber GHG fluxes from JWP

Data:
1. Find data
  - .txt files within the directory


```{r libraries, message=F, include=F}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)
library(stringi)
library(broom)
library(reshape2)
```

## TIMEPOINTS

```{r get-sampling-dates, include=F}
# dates
getwd()
```

## t0

```{r list-files}
files <- list.files("./data/gc-raw/20231014/t0", pattern = ".txt")
length(files)
```

get the sample log

**To get the sample log I need to export a subset of the full .xlsx sample log data as a .csv file**

```{r read-sample-log, warning=F,message=F}
sample_log <- read_csv("./data/gc-raw/20231014/t0/sample_log.csv", na = c("N/A", "<NA>")) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(date_collected = mdy(date_collected),
         gc_run_date = mdy(gc_run_date)) %>% 
  mutate(row = row_number(),
         timepoint = "t0") %>%
  slice_head(n=34)

glimpse(sample_log)

#sample_log <- slice_head(sample_log, n=73)
```

read in gc files

```{r read-gc-files, output = F, echo = F}
data <- lapply(paste0("./data/gc-raw/20231014/t0/", files), read_delim, delim = "\t",skip = 80, n_max = 15)
data[[1]]
```

get CO2 peak heights

```{r co2-heights}
peak_heights <- bind_rows(data, .id = "row") %>%
  filter(Name %in% c("CO2","CH4","N2O")) %>%
  select(row, Name, Height) %>%
  mutate(row = as.numeric(row), Height = as.numeric(Height)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = row, names_from = Name, values_from = Height, values_fn = max)

```

bind sample log to peak heights
```{r}
gc_data_tidy <- left_join(peak_heights, sample_log, by = "row") %>%
  # mutate(ecosystem = ifelse(is.na(ecosystem), "STD", ecosystem), date_collected=mdy("11/11/2023")) %>% 
  select(row, date_collected, timepoint, gc_run_date, filename, ecosystem, rep = chamber_number, 2, 3, 4)

gc_data_tidy
```

```{r}
write_csv(gc_data_tidy, "./data/tidy/231014/231014_t0_gc_peak_heights.csv")
```

## Re-read in tidy data

```{r, message=FALSE}
gc_data_tidy <- read_csv("./data/tidy/231014/231014_t0_gc_peak_heights.csv")
```


get std stats across all runs

```{r}
std_heights <- gc_data_tidy %>% 
  filter(ecosystem == "STD" & !is.na(gc_run_date)) %>% 
  group_by(gc_run_date) %>% 
  summarize(mean_co2_height = mean(CO2, na.rm = T),
            mean_ch4_height = mean(CH4, na.rm = T),
            mean_n2o_height = mean(N2O, na.rm = T),
            
            co2_precision = sd(CO2, na.rm = T)/mean_co2_height*100,
            ch4_precision = sd(CH4, na.rm = T)/mean_ch4_height*100,
            n2o_precision = sd(N2O, na.rm = T)/mean_n2o_height*100) 
std_heights
```

combine std heights with unknowns

```{r}
unknown_std_heights <- gc_data_tidy %>% 
  filter(ecosystem != "STD") %>% 
  left_join(std_heights, by = "gc_run_date")
```

calculate ghg in ppm

```{r}
ghg_ppm <- unknown_std_heights %>% 
  mutate(co2_ppm = CO2 * (998/mean_co2_height),
         ch4_ppm = CH4 * (10.2/mean_ch4_height),
         n2o_ppm = N2O * (1/mean_n2o_height),
         date_collected = ymd("2023-10-14")) 
ghg_ppm
```

write data

```{r}
write_csv(ghg_ppm, "./data/tidy/231014/231014_t0_ghg_ppm.csv")
```
